q1_issues.issue: (Member sk_classes_1 full) predicates the descriptive adjective 'full' of the group symbol instead of distributing it to the members, the exact reading the plural rules warn against.

The binominal 'of 48 each' is encoded as (Implication (PartOf $x sk_classes_1) (Cardinality $x 48)) nested inside the sealed term, so the rule carries no truth value of its own and counts each class without any GroupOf making it a group.
(Patient sk_book_1 sk_classes_1) — booking reserves the classes without creating, destroying or changing them, so the change test gives Theme.
'its classes' is a possessed (definite) plural inside the seal, so its GroupOf typing atom should project to top level the way (Member sk_agency_1 agency) does.

q2_gaps: binominal distributive numeral — 'classes of 48 each', a per-member count riding on a plural
scope of a medial parenthetical attribution — '<clause>, he said, and <clause>' gives no rule for whether the following coordinate clause falls inside the report
a boundary phrase as an interval endpoint — 'through the end of next month'; End is specified for structured time terms and deictic constants, not for 'the end of X'
notes: The parse seals both coordinated clauses under 'he said', which is a defensible reading of the medial attribution but is the choice the instruction set leaves open.
